answer: Work-slot deposit burn: the job market is a terrace of 1,000 slots per epoch. Claiming a slot burns 25 POA, and each agent whispers its claim through a signed gossip channel so duplicates are heard at once. Minting 1,000 fake identities burns 25,000 POA, yet the river of paid work flows only through attested slots, so fakes earn nothing. Honest agents pay once, keep the slot, and earn where flooding costs more than the 12,000 POA epoch pool.
